source_claim_record.exact_statement: For every finite ordered priority controller formed by disjoint point tests A_1,...,A_k of arbitrary positive widths and selecting pairwise disjoint independent Boolean data cores u_1,...,u_k with default +1, every finite adaptive physical restriction tree respecting priority order for control queries, with arbitrary data interruptions, has H(F)<=U_root+R_root+(3/ln2)T_data+(8+2/ln2)Pi_ctrl+E[H_leaf-U_leaf-R_leaf]. Here U=sum p_j[H(u_j)-eta((Eu_j)^2)], R=sum eta(p_j)Var(u_j), T_data=sum visited-node weights p_j beta_j^2, and Pi_ctrl is same-tree actual controller influence spent. At controller-resolved leaves the final term is eta((Eu_leaf)^2)<=I_leaf/ln2. The local repeated-fallback point test F=A u+(1-A)G, with u,G on disjoint blocks, satisfies D_control-kappa<=(8+2/ln2)Inf_control even though the same G occurs in both children. All entropy units are bits. There is no depth, width or number-of-stages bound, and inherited U and unresolved terminal entropy are retained.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cube; pairwise disjoint controller point-test blocks and independent disjoint data-core blocks; genuine Boolean signs.
Controller queries respect priority order; arbitrary adaptive data interleavings and finite frontiers; irrelevant blocks skipped.
Repeated fallback data between children allowed; distinct selected cores do not share physical data.
Bits; eta(0)=0; unresolved stopping profile retained, no universal inherited-core entropy bound.
